neighbours.label: a preposition that introduces the field or domain of someone's expertise or activity ('training in', 'leaders in', 'charged with', 'the study of')
fire: Most of the surgeons on staff have advanced training in pediatric cardiology.
The firm owns several subsidiaries that are world leaders in industrial coatings.
She received a national prize for her achievements in marine biology.
The new agency is charged with cybersecurity for all federal departments.
His doctoral thesis was a study of medieval trade routes in the Baltic.
The professor is an expert in tax law and has written three books on it.
Graduates of the program are ready to work in the field of computer networks.
The foundation gives grants for research in renewable energy.
quiet: Most of the surgeons on staff live in apartments near the hospital.
The firm owns several warehouses that sit in an industrial park by the river.
She received a national prize at a ceremony in the capital last spring.
The new agency moved with its staff to a building near the station.
His doctoral thesis was finished in the winter of his fourth year in Riga.
The professor sat in his office and waited for the students to arrive.
Graduates of the program met in the main hall on the last day of term.
The foundation gives grants in the autumn and announces them in December.

notes: Card: weak pole (max 8.75); peaks on ' in', ' of', ' with', ' on' after training/leaders/achievements/study/charged, plus Russian 'области'. Near misses use the same prepositions in a spatial or temporal sense.
